blueprint.product: ProcureSprint – a multi-page static web procurement portal (RFQs, awards, orders, shipments, goods receipt, supplier portal, administration, reports) previewed as-is.
users: U-01 Buyer/procurement staff and administrators who run sourcing, receive goods and administer the system
U-02 Supplier who responds to RFQs, fulfils orders and ships

J-07 Administer users, roles, master data and reports: Administration hub, Users filter and preview, Roles & Permissions, Master Data, Spend Analytics and Reports
J-01 to J-03 Other sourcing and order journeys exist in the uploaded project and are kept as-is
